en: Black-and-white postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a traditional house with Islamic-Andalusian style arches, carved stucco, zellij tilework on floors and columns, and low seating around the walls. A round table covered with a cloth stands in the middle of the salon. The scene is lit by daylight from a window in the background. Printed caption in French appears at the bottom margin.
